tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga skal ba bzang po'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mchod pa'i cho ga skal bzang 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rab rgyas in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po gang*/ /nyin byed 'bum phrag brgya yis 'khyud pa'i dpal/ /rnam kun rig mar kha sbyor ye shes sku/ /bde chen rol pa rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal gus pas mchod pa 'bul/ /dang ba'i yid kyis dang bas mchod cing bstod/ /rab 'byams mchod sprin rab 'byams zhing gi tshogs/ /yongs su gang bas yongs su mchod par bgyi/ /rab mdzes mchog ldan bde dpal mchog mdzes rab/ /phul phyin mchog gi mchog gyur phul phyin phul/ /mkhyen pas shes bya stong pa'i shes pas mkhyen/ /gus pas 'dud cing 'dud cing 'dud pas gus/ /ye shes shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mchog rnam kun/ /rnam kun kun nas mngon gyur kun shes rab/ /shes rab rab mchog de nyid dngos kun mkhyen/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gter la rab btud de/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas ni/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la/ /mchod pa'i tshul zhig 'dir 'bri ste/ /rnal 'byor can rnams rangs par gyis/ /'dir he ru ka dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i phyi rol mchod pa las brtsams te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med par mchod pa'i cho ga ngag 'don lag tu blang ba ni 'di yin te/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po la/ sdom ni/ rdor dril byin rlabs sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ /byin dbab zhu 'bul skyabs sems rdor sems bsgom/ nang mchod byin gyis brlab dang bdag bskyed bsgom/ /dang po ni/ thal mo sbyar/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/

lag mthil g.yas su nyi ma/ g.yon du zla ba/ rnam lnga 'dod skor byas la/ rdo rje 'di nyid rdo rje sems dpa'/ dril bu 'di nyid rdo rje snyems ma'i ngo bo gnyis ka'ang stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra rdo rje mthe bong dang ming med kyis bzung satwa hāṃḥhi hi hi hi hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ < dril bu snyems pa dang bcas pas sta zur g.yon du bzung*/ > badz+ra ghan+ḍe hūṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa mnyes par bya'o/ /hūṃ sems can rmongs pa las sgrol ba/ /rnam thar chos kyi bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje gsor pa mdzes pas te/ spro dang bcas pas dril bu bzung*/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ hoḥhoḥhoḥ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa lā ni pradzña pā ra mi ta na da saṃ bhā we badz+ra dharma hri da ya ṇi san+to ṣa ṇi/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ hoḥhoḥhoḥ ā khaṃ swāhā/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gsum pa gnas yo byin rlabs ni spyi dang mthun pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal bskyed bsdu dang thal mo sbyar nas/ sems can don du sems dge bas/ /rnal 'byor pa yi tshogs rnams kun/ /tshul bzhin cho gar ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor la ni nye gnas mdzod/ /gal te cho ga'i slob dpon yod na zhu ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo/ /lnga pa skyabs 'gro/ drug pa sems bskyed/ bdun pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams ni bde mchog nyid kyi chog rim bzhin no/ /brgyad pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha/ sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa'i nang du hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ las sha lnga/ baṃ maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu zhu zhing bskol bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dgu pa ni/ mngon rtogs rgyas par bsgom par bya la/ de tsam mi nus na bsnyen sgrub bzhi tsam bsgom/ de yang mi nus na 'di ltar/ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ shri yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /gsum/ rang bde mchog he ru ka phyag gnyis pa/ oṃ a āḥ.i ī sogs lan gsum/ lte bar zla ba la ā li kā li lan gsum du g.yon du bskor ba/ de las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa ba spu'i khung bu nas spros/ 'gro ba thams cad rnam par sbyangs/ 'khor lo lnga'i go 'phang la bkod/ bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ slar 'dus lte ba la thim/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa sogs/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzña na badz+ra swa bha wāt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāk+tsi t+ta badz+ra swa bhā wāt+ma ko3 haṃ/ gsum/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ spyi bo'i nor bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer mo phyag rgya lnga dang ldan ma/ dbu skra grol ba/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /phaiṃ/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/

yi ge bdun pa'am/ nyer gnyis pa ci rigs par bzla'o// skabs 'dir rjes gzhig gi tshul bsgoms la ldang ngo*/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bsrung 'khor maṇ+ḍal lhar skyed dang*/ /thugs bskul mchod gtong dbang bskur blang*/ bdun las/ dang po ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga bān badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa las sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros/ sum+bha lan gnyis/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar khyab pa'i sngags kyi gzugs las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre mda'i dra ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ri bha wa bhan+dha hūṃ/ gsum/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra wi ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dza la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lārka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ gnyis pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal dngos su sngar bshams grub na 'dir yid kyis dmigs pa dang tshig cha rnams brjod/ sngar ma bshams na 'di nyid du dngos su maṇ+ḍal bya'o/ /skad cig gis rtsa ba'i bla ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ oṃ badz+ro da ke chu byin rlabs hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ dung chos len hriḥswāhā/ oṃ waṃ kha khrus swāhā/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā bhi ṣe gdong bkru'o ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ /oṃ gnas gsum du reg āḥhūṃ/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha gdan la me tog bzhag badz+ra ā sa na hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pa ba na ba na ya swāhā/ oṃ khat+ta ro he me tog rna ltag tu gzer rak+ṣa maṃ/ sarba bighan bh+yaḥ oṃ badz+ro chu byin brlabs da ke hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ puṣ+pe/ ke tu rā dza ya ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyaka sam bu d+dha ya/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe/ puṣ+pe/ ma hā puṣ+pe/ me tog byin rlabs gu puṣ+pe puṣ+pa saṃ bhā we puṣ+po t+bha we puṣ+pa kir+ṇe swāhā/ oṃ go ma ba lci sogs byin rlabs ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra satwa bgegs sbyang ba ni bigh+naṃ nu sā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra re kha su re re kha bris khe swāhā/ ba lci chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin/ /grog sbur bsal ba bzod pa ste/ /brtson 'grus bya ba byed la brtson/ /bsam gtan der sems skad cig ma/ /ri mo legs 'bar shes rab bo/ /pha rol phyin pa drug rnams kyi/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal legs byas pa'o/ /'dir ni lus kyi las byas nas/ kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang*/ /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /lha dang mi las ches lhag cing*/ /zla ba lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ /nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas pa/ /mchog gi khyim du skye ba nyid/ /oṃ badz+ra re khe sarba bud+dha a dhi slar yang re kha bya ṣ+ṭhān+ta swāhā/ oṃ waṃ bkru' ོswāhā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra arka bi ma phyi'o la swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma me tog bkram ya/ sogs/ haṃ su me so so'i tshom bu bya ru na maḥ yaṃ bi de ha dwi pa na maḥ raṃ dzam bu dwi pa na maḥ laṃ go da nī dwi pa na maḥ waṃ ku ru dwi pa na maḥ yaḥyaḥ.u pa dwi pa na maḥ raḥraḥ u pa dwi pa na maḥ laḥ laḥ u pa dwi pa na maḥ waḥwaḥ.u pa dwi pa na maḥ laḥtu raṅga rat+nā ya na maḥ raḥ man+ti rat+nā ya na maḥ ya ga dza rat+nā ya na maḥ waḥs+t+rī rat+nā ya na maḥ yaḥkhat+ga rat+nā ya na maḥ ra ma ṇi rat+nā ya na maḥ waḥni dhi rat+nā ya na maḥ laḥtsakra rat+nā ya na maḥ oṃ a tsan+d+ra/ oṃ aḥsur+ya/ oṃ oṃ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhing 'byor ba tshad med pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba lta bu mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams kyi ngo bo nyid na maḥ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /rin chen kun bzang maṇ+ḍal bzang po'i mchod pa 'di/

/blo yi blangs nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar 'bul/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis rlab tu gsol/ gsum pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las chos 'byung dkar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ de'i nang du yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa/ dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa/ nang gi lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can gyi dbus su seng khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma hūṃ gi rnam par byon pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal dang sku lus in+d+ra nī la 'bar ba'i 'od can/ dus mtha'i sprin gnag ltar 'jigs pa/ g.yas zhal ston zla ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ rgyab zhal dzam+bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs ba ltar lham me ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang*/ mche ba'i myu gu bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ spyi bo'i nor bu dang*/ mi bskyod pas rnam par brgyan pa/ thod skam lnga lnga'i cod pan za ra tshags dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa/ g.yas lhag mas ḍā ma ru/ dgra sta/ mdung rtse gsum/ gri gug g.yon lhag mas kha ṭāṃ ga zhags pa/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan mo dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed mnan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang*/ mgo 'phreng dang*/ thal ba dang*/ nyams dgus brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ yum rdo rje phag mo/ thun mtshams dang li khri'i mdangs can/ rdo rje dang man chad gong bzhin/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i

nas pa'o/ /phaiṃ/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang he ru ka dbyer med pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ sum+bha sogs/ oṃ gu ru tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal le bh+ya/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ dkon mchog gsum la sogs bya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs/ yab kyi gnas su/ oṃ oṃ ha/ na ma ti/ swāhā hūṃ/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ hūṃ ho/ phaṭa haṃ/ yum gyi gnas su/ oṃ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ/ moṃ/ hreṃhreṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po la ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po la ni/ rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni shri he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /lce la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni ltung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ /rtsa sum cu rtsa drug rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa drug rkyang ma ro ma dbu ma bdud 'bral ma gtum mo rnams rdo rje phag mo/ khams nyer bzhi ni dpa' bo nyer bzhi/ dpyid kyi dpa' bo mi shigs pa gzhom du med pa'i thig le ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /spro na lus dkyil zhal phyag rdzogs par bskyed na legs/ long med pa dang mi spro na de dang der mos pa tsam bya'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sarba bī ra yo gi sogs gsum/ badz+ra shud+dha sogs/ bzhi pa ni/

oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bā ra swāhā/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ḍā ki nā ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lā me= khan+ṭa ro he= ru pi nī ye= oṃ pu dza o a go rā de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gri so sun si ma ku hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kā kā s+ya ā lu ka s+ya/ shwā na s+ya/ sū ka ra s+ya/ ya ma ḍa ḍhī= ya ma du tī yai/ ya ma daṃṣ+ti ṇe= ya ma ma tha nī= rnal 'byor ro gcig bdud rtsi 'thung bas rnam par dag pa'i thugs/ /gnas la sogs pa yul du bgrod pa rnam par dag pa'i gsung*/ /dpal ldan gnas kyi dbus su 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor mgon po mchog/bla ma mchog la mgo bos btud de rtag par phyag bgyi'o/ / de nas zhes sogs ngag chen pos/ /rgyud ni rdzogs par gyur pa gang*/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i 'dren pa mo/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /lha mo 'phreng bas brgyan pa'i sku yi rin po che lus kun dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ma yis rtag tu mdzes/ /'khor lo gnas kyi mgon po dri med lhan cig skyes/ /sdom pa'i rnal 'byor snying po la ni rtag phyag 'tshal/ /e yig rnam pa'i snying po khu ba'i gnas gyur pad+ma'i sbubs ni dam pa ste/ /de yi dbus su skyes pa'i dang mo dam pa kun+da ltar dkar thams cad dag /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas te lha mo mdzes ma'i gzhi/ /dri med lhan cig skyes pa'i gru bzhi 'dren pa la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa dang bral mchog gi lus can ma/ /dmar ba'i 'od chags rnam par rgyal ma khams gsum gzugs can ma/ /yon tan tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i sku mnga' rdo rje'i yan lag ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bskyed mdzad ma la rtag tu mngon par phyag bgyi'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum

brnyes/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /yid la med cing dmigs pa med/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/skabs 'dir ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod pa dang*/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa lta bu mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas/ dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu dbyangs bya ste/ spro na/ spel mar sbyar ba bdag gi zur du bkod pa bzhin dang*/ bsdu na/ rgyud tshig kho na bya ste/ hūṃ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yi/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rab tu rmongs pas sten par byed/ /a la la la la ho/ a i ā ā ra li ho/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ /a la la la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyis bde ba mchog/rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a i ā ā ra li ho/ rab dgyes mgon po khyod bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba stsol/ /dgyes ma'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyi gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol/ /thar ba'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /a la la la la ho/ a i ā ā ra li ho/ bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur/ /bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma dgyes pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /de yis mgon po bskul na ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blangs pas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yi/ /gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ zhes gsol ba btab pas mnyes nas dngos su mchod pa bdag gir mdzad par bsams la/ lnga pa mchod pa dngos ni/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma gsang sngags grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang mchod par 'os pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ zhu ba las mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong*/ rnam pa mchod rdzas 'byams klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā sogs/ snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo nam mkha' gang ba spros nas mchod/ sdom ni/ 1 chu dang 2 nyer spyod 3 gnyis dang 4'dod yon 5gnyis/ /6rin chen 7nye ba'i rin chen 8bkra shis rtags/ /9sgeg sogs 10rig ma 11bla med 12na bza' 13zas/ /14maṇ+ḍal 15khrus dang 16nyer mkho 17nang dang 18gsang*/ /19de nyid 20bstod pa 21rgyun bshags 22sdom bzung dang*/ /23lag mchod ces bya mchod pa nyer gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ mchod yon phal cher sogs dang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs sam/ yang na 'di ltar/ rnam dag yid 'ong lha yi rdzas/ /yan lag bdun ldan ar+gha'i rgyun/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar yang bzhes su gsol/ oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sat+ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ rnam dag yid 'ong = zhabs kyi pad+ma'i rnyogs sel spos kyi chu/ mchog tu sogs/ oṃ lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar/ /dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /me tog de ring bzhes nas su/ /'di la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /oṃ gu ru shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥpuṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ oṃ tsan+dan ga bur sbyar ba yi/ /dri zhim bdug spos dge ba yi/ /mthu dang ldan par bya ba 'di/ /bzhes nas byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ dhu pe/ oṃ mar me 'od zer 'bar ba 'di/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed/ /lha yi mig 'byed bkra shis pa/ /mar me khyed kyi bzhes su gsol/ ā lo ke oṃ sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa/ /sna tshogs ga pur sogs brgyan pa/ /sna tshogs yi ge hūṃ las byung*/ /dri 'di 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol/ gan+dhe/ kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ nai wi d+ya/

pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs/ /dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs dang*/ /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs pa/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ shap+ta/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa/ / mdzes ldan dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ tshig thog mtha' gnyis dang sngags kyi thog mtha' 'gre yid 'ong dud ka rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ dhu pe/ kun snang dmar ser= mar mes gang ba'i= ā lo ke gdung sel ljang khu= dri mchog byug pa'i= gan+dhe/ zhal zas sna tshogs= bdud rtsis gang ba'i= nai wi d+ya= chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /srid pa'i mtsho las rnam par rgyal/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bur ni/ /sems can kun la bstan par bgyi/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā dar+ṣe hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sgra yi rjes su 'gro ba yis/ /gang gis 'jig rten thams cad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi/ wī ni/ gang gi sangs rgyas zhing kun dang*/ /'jig rten pa yi khams kun du/ /bla med bsam mi khyab pa'i dri/ /rang gi lus la spro bar bya/ gan+dhe/ gang gis sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ /srog chags gyur pa thams cad la/ /lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog /sprul nas su ni sbyin par bya/ /rwa sa/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun dang yang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' sogs kun la/ /yang dag sbyor ba reg bya'i bde/ /nges par sbyar ba bya ba yin/ spar+she/ rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i bde ster ma/ /me long pi wang spos khang bza' btung snod/ /ras phran bzang dang pad+ma bhañdza naṃ/ /cang te'i sgra sgrogs kha ṭāṃ la brten ma/ /dkar sngo ser dang dmar dang ljang ba'i gzugs/ /gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan dri ldan bcud ldan dang*/

/bde ldan lang tshos dregs pa'i smin legs ma/ /nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa= 'dod yon gyi tshigs bcad/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyang bya'o/ /dri med dzam+bu chu bo'i gser bzang las/ /bsod nams bzo bos mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba/ /lha mi'i mdzes pa kun las phul byung zhing*/ /blta bas mi ngom rdzu 'phrul shugs nyid las/ /rang byung rtsibs stong ta la bdun srid du/ /byung tshe phyogs las rgyal ba mchog thob pa/ /'khor lo rin chen dam pa 'di 'bul bas/ / rgyal byed dran pa'i 'khor lo thob par shog /oṃ saṅgu ru shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī nāṃ tsakra rat+nā pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ chu zheng phun tshogs thal kar zla 'od can/ /mche ba drug ldan dul ba'i spyod pas mdzes/ /sngon chad legs par byas pa'i mthu nyid las/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkha' la rab 'gro zhing*/ /mkha' lding sa srungs bu ltar mgyogs pa yis/ /sa chen rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kun tu bskor/ /glang po rin chen phul bas mtshan ma rnams/ /'joms byed shes rab glang po thob par shog /hasti rat+na/ rab mdzes rma bya'i mgrin 'dra'i spu sdug can/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'dod pa yi/ /don kun rdzogs par sgrub byed nam mkha'i lam/ /gus par spyod pa gser gyi rgyal mtshan can/ /cang shes rlung las rgyal ba sprin gyi shugs/ /yid ltar mgyog pa'i rta mchog 'di phul bas/ /ma lus chos la mngon shes bgrod pa can/ /brtson 'grus bzhon pa mchog gi 'gro bar shog /a shwa rat+na/ kun tu sngo ba mtshungs med baiḍūr+ya/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i rin chen cha brgyad pa/ /byed po med cing phun tshogs 'od zer gyis/ /me dang nyi ma'i 'od kyang rnam par gnon/ /dga' mgur 'gro shing dgos pa mchog ster la/ /'khor kun khyab pa'i 'od zer dpag yas can/ /bsam pa rdzogs byed nor bu 'di 'bul bas/

/chos kyi snang ba'i dga' bas tshim par shog /ma ṇi rat+na/ dga' tshal lha yi bu mo'i gzugs mdzes can/ /'dul ba'i cho ga phun tshogs bstan bcos dang*/ /bzo dang snyan ngag sgyu rtsal kun shes shing*/ /'dzum zhing snyan par smra mkhas mtshungs pa'i gzugs/ /reg pa mchog ldan lus sems bde ba'i rgyu/ /ha cang che chung gzugs min dri bzang ster/ /phul bas sgrib pa kun las rnam thar ba'i/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba'i 'tsho bar shog/s+t+rī rat+na/ lag na rdo rje sred med bu yi stobs/ /'jam shing yid 'ong snyan pa'i tshig kyang 'byin/ /'dzangs shing gsal la yid gzhung lha mig ldan/ khor yug gter gyi bdag po'i don kun byed/ /byams dang snying rje mnga' ba dge ba'i bdag /'dod dgur 'dzud pa'i mi mchog 'di phul bas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs don/ /kun 'byor ting 'dzin mchog la dbang thob shog /gṛ haspa ti rat+na/ dpa' zhing brtul phod yan lag mchog gi gzugs/ /pha rol dpung 'joms mi mthun med byed pa/ /sngar ldang bsam pa dge zhing lta bas go /ma smad rgyas shing rdzogs pa'i legs byas can/ /'dod dgur 'gro ba'i blon po rin chen 'di/ /phul bas ji lta ji snyed chos rnams la/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes dam pa yis/ /rtsol med gnas pa'i btang snyoms thob par shog pu ru ṣa rat+na/ de tsam mi nus na/ lha rdzas las grub sogs sam/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs bya/ ral gri lpags pa skyed tshal khang khyim dang*/ /gzims cha gos dang mchil lham rin po che/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khaṭ+ga twa ka ba na gṛ ha sha sas+ya bas+t+ra mo tsa u pa rat+na pad+ma can dkar dpal be'u 'dzin/ /'jigs byed ma dkar 'khor lo bsnams/ /'od ldan sngon mo pad+ma thogs/ /rnam rgyal ma sngon rgyal mtshan can/ /mdangs ldan dmar mo gdugs dkar 'dzin/ /dkar sham dmar skya gter gyi bum/

/dri med ljang khu dung dkar bsnams/ /yid gzhung ljang khu gser nya thogs/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad po yis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchod par bgyi/ /bde legs phun tshogs stsal nas kyang*/ /kun tu zhi zhing dge gyur ciga'adir spro na/ deng nas brtsam ste rdzogs sangs rgyas/ sogs/ sgegs sogs brgyad dang*/ gdan bzhi las 'byung mchod pa nyi shu dang sgyu ma bde mchog gi lha mo nyi shu'i mchod pa bya ste shin tu legs so/ /'dir ni re zhig bzhag go/ rang gi snying ga nas ā li bcu drug spros/ lha mo bcu drug tu gyur/ oṃ wī ni badz+ri ṇī hūṃ aḥ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ ma/ sogs sam/ mthon mthing lang tshos dregs pa'i yid 'phrog ma/ sogs gang rung bya/ de tsam mi nus na/ bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs gsal ba/ /pi waṃ gling bur rnga zlum rdza rnga can/ /rgod dang sgeg dang glu len bro gar mkhan/ /me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog ma/ /gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos 'byung ma/ /bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma/ /rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis/ /he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dges mdzod/ oṃ wī ni badz+ri ṇī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ waṃ se badz+ri ṇī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de bzhin du/ mri taṃ gi mu ra dze ha se lā se gī ti nirti puṣ+pe dhu pe dī pe gan+dhe ra sa spar+she dharmā dhā tu/ 'di dag rgyas pa la dga' na kho bos zur du dgod par bya'o/ /shin tu nyung ngus ni tshigs bcad med kyang chog go/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can gdung ba tshim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*/ / mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ /rin chen me tog la sogs char/ /rgyun mi chad pa 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gi de bzhin gshegs/

/mgon po sras dang bcas pa mchod/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag las/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig oṃ las byung ba'i gos zung chos kyi dbyings kyi rab 'byams mtha' klas par gyur/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu/ sogs/ mgon khyod bkres skyems mi mnga' yang*/ /'o thug bur khu bdud rtsi'i chu/ /bza' dang bca' ba rgya chen po/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos kyi mchog/kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/ a kā ro/ sogs/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa 'bul ba dang bsdus pa lan mang du bya/ ri mchog gser gyi ri dang rol mtsho rgya ldan khor yug bcas/ /gling rnams lha dang mi yi 'byor pa kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gzugs mdzes yan lag mchog ldan zag med bde ster lha mos spras/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnam dag zhing du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ ji ltar ltams pa sogs kyi khrus gsol/ sku phyis dang*/ dri dang na bza' 'bul ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang*/ /reg na bde ba lha yis gos/ /mkha' lding khyu mchog rma bya dang*/ /glang po rta sogs theg pa'i mchog /dgos 'dod 'byung ba 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo thog dang*/ /dpag bsam shing dang 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /bum bzang nam mkha' gang bas mchod/ /bdag gis lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba kun yang 'bul/ /gser dngul mu tig baiḍūr+ya/ /rin chen zhing rnams bkang nas 'bul/ /dbang sngon rdo rje pad+ma dmar/ /markata byu ru dzam+bu'i gser/ /zla shel rin chen bdun gyi ri/ /zhing gi rdul snyed dbul bar bgyi/ /ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga/ /dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ /me tog kar+ṇi ka ra dang*/ /mā li ka dang yu thig ka /me tog kā ra bī ra yang*/ /bsam gtan stobs kyis khyed la 'bul/ /mi 'jigs seng ge rin chen khri/

/pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan mchog dang*/ /rna rgyan dang ni gdub bu dang*/ /mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang*/ /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ /dbu rgyan dar dpyangs do shal bcas/ /rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /dkar dang nag dang ser skya dang*/ /de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang*/ /me tog phreng ba du ma dang*/ /bla bre dag dang dar dpyangs pa'i/ /mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes/ /de bzhin bza' bya btung ba yis/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas mchod par bya/ /gser ni brgya stong du ma dang*/ /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang*/ /glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang*/ /chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid/ /bran pho bran mo sring mo dang*/ /blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra u pas+tha na nir+ya t+ya mi/ de nas nang mchod sngar bzhin byin brlab bya/ bla ma dang dkyil gyi 'khor lo rab 'byams kyi chos bdud rtsi bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur ciga.oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gtso/ /nyes bral zhi ba'i btung ba mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dang shing*/ / bcos pa'i myos byed rnam pa lnga/ /shes rab rang bzhin dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba badz+ra gā mi ni sarba bha k+ṣaṃ shodha ya guh+ya badz+ri ṇī hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas rig ma'i tshogs spros te/ bde stong gis mchod par gyur/ sa khams dag pa'i dpa' mo che/ /ltung byed rdo rje sangs rgyas spyan/ /rtag pa'i sangs rgyas shes rab yum/ /gti mug dga' mas dges par mdzod/ oṃ āḥmo ha ra ti hūṃ/ chu khams= gsod byed/ mā ma kī rdo rje nyi ma'i zhe sdang dga' mas/ dwe ṣa ra ti me khams= 'gugs byed gos dkar mo/ pad+ma gar gyi 'dod chags dga' mas/ rā ga ra ti/ rlung khams= gar dbang sgrol ma ste/ rta yi rgyal po'i/

rdo rje dga' mas/ badz+ra ra ti/ mkha' dbyings pad can dbyings phyug ma khrag 'thung rdo rje/ rdo rje sems mas= oṃ āḥsatwa badz+ri ṇi hūṃ/ rig lnga las byung phyag rgya mchog /gar ma chos ma rdo rje ma/ /gdol ma de bzhin bram ze mo/ /lhan skyes gnas skyes rigs skyes dang*/ /mthar skyes ma yis mchod par bgyi/ /gau rī la sogs lha mo brgyad/ khwa gdong ma sogs ma mo'i tshogs/ /gzugs can ma dang tsum+bi ka /lā ma yongs gyur byis bcas mo/ /mi ldog e hi ka lha mo/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams bdun gyis mchod/ /rdo rje pad+ma byin brlab nas/ /snyoms 'jug 'pho med bde chen thob/ /rang bzhin snang ba yongs dag pa/ /zhu bdes khams gsum kun khyab pa/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes par bgyi/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/

lan bdun/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra sābha wāt+ma ko3haṃ/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gis/ /rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar phyung*/ /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog /rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min zhing*/ /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /nges par sregs pa de yi spos/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /yi ge hūṃ las yang dag byung*/ /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /bde chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*/ /de nyid kyis kyang byugs pa ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /'dir ni gang dag gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag bsten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya/ /'gog pa'i rdo rjer zhugs pa'i sems/ /rang nyams dpyid kyi dpa' bo glu/ /gzhom med na da'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /thugs kyi rdo rje mchod par bgyi/ /sngags ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bstod pa ni spro zhing long yod na/ rgyun chags dang*/ sgyu 'phrul sbyin pa la sogs pa bya/ de tsam mi shes na/ bskal pa'i me 'bar sogs sam/ rgyal ba sprul pa sogs dang*/ mtshan brgya bya/ de yang mi nus na/ rkang brgyad/ rkang brgyad gnyis dang rol mo dkrol ba'am yang na dril bu tsam dkrol/ mchan/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ sogs bya/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs kyi khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang khrag 'thung bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med dbang phyug sku dang dbyer med cing*/ /bde chen 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas la sogs sprin spro ba/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sku la= dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'khor 'das stong par mdzad pa'i thugs rje can/

/gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la= /nam mkha' lta bur thams cad thogs med cing*/ /'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /thugs dam dbang gis sgrub la rtser dgongs pa'i/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la= /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes te/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo ma lus bcad pa'i phyir/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal gnyis rdo rje'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud/ /de nas bla ma spyi dang sgos kyi bstod pa rnams 'di la dril bu sogs mi byed/ ci rigs par bya'o/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa ni shes na bhu ba ri pa'i rgyun bshags bya/ de mi shes na dā ri ka'i rgyun bshags sam/ yang na 'di ltar/ oṃ āḥdapal ldan rdo rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad mo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /skyob pa chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'os sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /rgyal bas gsung ba'i chos rnams dang*/ /tshul khrims bzang ldan dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /byas dang byed du bcug dang yid rangs pa'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jig byed pa'i/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang*/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yid rangs shing*/ /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems skyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur

te/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa myur thob shog/ bsdu na de tsam bya/ spro na/ skye zhing skye ba sogs kyang gdon no/ /de nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs dang*/ spro na/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la sogs dang*/ nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ sogs kyang bya/ bsdu na rigs lnga'i sdom par ma 'dus pa med do/ /bsangs sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang lag mthil gyi sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma gnyis par zla ba/ sor mo dang sen mo rnams dang 'dab ma gzhan dang lte bar nyi ma/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bcu gnyis/ oṃ ha na ma hi sogs dang*/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ sogs/ rdo rje sems dpa' rnam snang mdzad/ /pad+ma gar dbang he ru ka /rdo rje nyi ma rta mchog dang*/ /rdo rje phag mo shin rje ma/ / rmongs byed sbyong byed skrag byed ma/ /tsaṇ+ḍi ka yi ngo bor gnas/ phaiṃ/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad las lha tshogs gnyis pa rnams lag pa'i mkhrig mar byon ste dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ hūṃ baṃ maṃ taṃ paṃ laṃ puṃ dzaṃ oṃ aṃ goṃ raṃ deṃ maṃ kaṃ oṃ triṃ koṃ kaṃ laṃ kaṃ hiṃ/ preṃ greṃ sau+oṃ suṃ naṃ saṃ maṃ kuṃ hūṃ/ brgyad brjod/ lag pa'i sa'i khams la ni ltung byed ma'o/ /sogs dra ba can no/ /de nas/ oṃ ha sogs dang hūṃ baṃ sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes dang por nang mchod/ de nas khu ba'i rdzas gzhan/ de nas gong bu'i rdzas/ mthar me tog 'bul te/ oṃ baṃ/ sogs dang*/ hūṃ baṃ/ sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes so/ /ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ wī ni badz+ri sogs dang*/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de nas mdun bskyed bla ma he ru ka la me tog dbul te/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrab tu grub par mdzod/

/mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes shig ho/ oṃ shri badz+ra hai he sogs la/ sngags re re'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ puṣ+paṃ pra tits+tsha na maḥ zhes pa btags so/ /drug pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung nas/ bdud rtsi lnga'i bar gong bzhin/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ nyi ma 'char ka'i kha dog ltar gyur pa'i rlangs pa las grub pa hūṃ las kha ṭ+wāṃ ga hūṃ gis mtshan pa mgo bo thur du blta ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin la bdud rtsi babs/ de nyid zhu ste 'dres/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ oṃ a ā nas/ k+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā yongs su gyur pas/ oṃ dkar po/ ā dmar po/ hūṃ sngon po/ de'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ de rnams bdud rtsir zhu ste gtor ma la thim pas kha dog dang dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ phaiṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya staṃ dri sh+ya ho/ lan lnga/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/ khyod kyi dngos po mtha' dag nam mkha' dang ni 'dra bar gzigs/ /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chus rlan sems la ni/ /mdzod cig mdzod cig lha mo bdag la dges par mdzod/ oṃ kha kha sogs dang*/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ar+ghaṃ sogs/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ sogs sam/ oṃ 'jig rten kun gtso mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /'jigs byed drag po stobs ldan pa/ /bde gshegs sras sogs bran mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can/ /dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas/ /de bzhin khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang*/ /brgya byin 'dod dga' chung mar bcas//lha chen 'khor bcas tshogs rnams dang*/ /phyogs skyong brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/

/klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo bsus 'dzin ma/ /dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dang*/ /'gro ba drug po 'khor bcas rnams/ /lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs byas nas/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs 'dzin rnams/ /gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i dam tshig can/ /mchod gtor rgyan dang bcas pa bzhes/ /dam tshig srungs shig dam tshig can/ /las la brtson pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig/las mdzad rdo rje bran bcas pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las sgrub cing*/ /theg chen gsang sngags bsrung ba dang*/ /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dbang bkra shis 'phel ba dang*/ /dge legs 'bras bu grub par mdzod/ 'dir ni lag mchod gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa ste/ rgyas 'bring gzhan du btsal bar bya'o/ /sgos kyi chos skyong la gtor ma gtong na'ang*/ 'dir gtong bzlas pa'ang skabs 'dir bya ste/ thun mongs ma yin pa'i gnad zhal las shes so/ /bdun pa ni/ chos 'di nyid kyi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i bstod pa dang*/ gsol 'debs rnams bya/ sngar bzhin dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glus gsol ba btab/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// sogs bya/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs gsum/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ lan gsum/ rdo rje 'di nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa dang*/ hi hi hi hūṃ phaṭa/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyem tshul bdag po'i bdag /oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe ra ṇi nas/ a khaṃ swāhā/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' chog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/

/yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu sgrags/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ su ra ta staṃ ā haṃ/ dbang bskur te spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung shig rdo rje byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdul phra rab tu gyur pa lhan cig skyes pa brtan pa'i mthar bdag gi lce thog tu bzhaga'adas pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ye shes las sprul pa'i rig ma'i lha mo bdag la gnang*/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ oṃ shī shī shīta ha ha ha swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ rdo rje snying po nam mkha' mtshungs/ /rdul bral thar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ / 'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma ste/ /phyi rol yul ni sdangs pa'o/ /rig 'di bor nas 'di las ni/ /gzhan pa'i thabs kyi sangs rgyas med/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod cig bu/ /brtul zhugs kun gyi bla ma'i bla/ /der cung zad mnyam par bzhag deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi 'drar sems can thams cad kyi/ /don ni bdag nyid kun gyis kyai/

/gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ lan gsum/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ sogs bya/ gal te tshogs kyi bya ba dang 'brel na/ skabs 'dir tshogs mchod bzhin bya ste/ lhag gtor rdzogs kyi bar du btang ngo*/ /gsum pa rjes la/ sngar bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ sngar ye shes pa'i mchod pa bzhin mchod pa bya/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ he ru ka'i yig brgya mang du brjod/ bdag ni mi shes nas/ bdag skyabs mchi/ ma 'byor pa dang= lhag ma dang ni sogs/ tshul khrims tsan+dan gyis lus byugs/ /bsam gtan gyi ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /so so'i skye bor gyur gang dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma thob dbang gis dang*/ /nye bar mkho ba ma yin dang*/ /brjed ngad shes bzhin ma yin pas/ /cung zad cho ga nyer ma tshang*/ /de dag bkru zhing bzod mdzad rigs/ /cho ga'i bya ba ma tshang ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang*/ /de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs/ /'jig rten skyong rnams bzod mdzad rigs/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing*/ /'du dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ lha mo tshad ma sogs/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa= sogs rnam lnga 'dod skor dang 'khyud rgya bya/ yo ga shud+dha sogs/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wa naṃ/ badz+ra muḥ dkyil 'khor la regagator mgron rnams gshegs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rang gi spyi bor byon 'od du zhu/ dpral ba yan chad gang*/ bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs/

bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med mnyam pa nyid la 'jog rang he ru kar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su/ oṃ oṃ ha sogs / yum gyi gnas rnams su/ oṃ oṃ baṃ sogs/ sum+bha tshar gnyis kyis mtshams rngam bya/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sogs/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig dran rtog thams cad thugs bde ba chen po'i cho 'phrul du rnam par dag go /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba= sogs/ skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du nas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig la gnas shog rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang nas/ mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog shes shing spro na/ 'khor lo ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du shog / gi bar yang bya/ gal te tshogs 'khor dang 'brel ba dang*/ yon bdag yod na/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang*/ dpa' bo rnams la bza' dang btung ba khyod kyis drangs/

khyod la rtag tu bsrung ba mchog gi sbyor ba dang*/ yang na/ yid la 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par shog ces pa'ang bya'o/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med cing*/ gang gi lam nas grol ba yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid du grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /srid pa gsum 'bar sku sogs dang*/ /bde ba phun tshogs yang dag ldan/ /nad med dge ba'i sems dang ni/ /'dod dang thar sogs yang dag thob/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig de nas/ dpa' bo gnyis med mchod pas skye ba 'di la ni/ /sgrib pa zad dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'gyur bar shog /skye ba kun tu mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro ba nyid gyur cig /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs bcu gnyis su/ /dam tshig brda dang bde spyod rol ba yis/ /bu bzhin dgongs pas bdag sgrib dag gyur te/ /bde ba mchog gi sa la 'god par shog /bla ma'i zhabs la rtag tu 'dud byed cing*/ /rdo rje dbang mo'i zhabs dran gyur nas kyang*/ /btsun mo'i shu kra'i tshogs la rtag spyod cing*/ / gsang ba'i pad+mor rol zhing mchod byed shog /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi'i/ /zhal mthong de yi ngo bor bdag gyur te/ /'gro ba bde ba dam pas 'phongs rnams kyi/ /nyer 'tsho rin chen lta bur bdag gyur cig /rnam pa mang po'i bsod nams 'di dag kyang*/ /bdag gzhan dge ba mchog ni bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'joms pa/ /'gro la mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /rnam par rtog pa kun las 'das pa yi/ /bde chen 'khor lo zag pa med pa'i dbyings/ /ā li kā li rtog med snyoms 'jug mar/ /bsags pa'i dge rnams yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang*/

/yun ring 'gro ba'i don bsgrub don la 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang*/ /gtso bo sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par 'gro bas dbang bskur ba/ /srid gsum rdo rje rol par lhan cig de yi go 'phang thob par shog /rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer mtha' dag bsal nas he ru ka gtso mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /'khor los yongs bskor rgyal ba bla med ye shes 'byung gnas thar pa dam pa'i grong*/ /sbyin pa la sogs rnams kyis 'gro ba'i yid la re ba yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog /'dir ni shin tu brtse ba che ldan 'phags pa'i dpal 'byor rtag par myong bar shog / de nas bkra shis ni bla ma'i rim pa rnams kyang spro na bya ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bkra shis dang*/ bdag gis kyang 'bri bar 'gyur bas de ltar yang bya la/ de tsam mi nus na/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo= sogs dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba= sogs ci rigs byas la/ mthar/ nyin mo bde legs= sogs/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ de bzhin du 'don pa spros la/ dam chos tshogs kyis= dge 'dun rnams kyis= mes po yis kyang= dbang po yis kyang= 'jig rten skyong bas= dkar phyogs skyong bas deng 'dir stsol/ zhes bya'o/ /gang ltar bkra shis dang smon lam yang rgyal ba'i bka' las byung ba zhig gis thog drangs nas byin chags par bya'o/ /yi dam sgrub mchod las gzhan du bla ma dang*/ bla ma mchod pa las gzhan du yi dam mchod par sems na gnad las gol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir bla ma dang lhan cig tu shes pas mchod do/ /'di ltar nyams su blangs pas bla ma'i bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang*/ pho nya lhan cig skyes grub ni/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ste / /yid ni nang du chud pa yis/ /'dod pa yi ni dngos grub bya/ zhes gsungs te/ bde mchog gi rgyud/ gzhung mnyam pa'am mthong bas lhag par yid ches dang ngo mtshar skye'o/ /slob dpon ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/

/mchod pa'i cho ga yi ger bris pa las/ /dpag yas bsod nams thob pa gang yin des/ /phan bdes sa dang bar snang gang bar shog /de ltar 'di ni 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud thams cad dang rgya gzhung yid ches pa mang po dang*/ khyad par nā ro ta pa'i sras kyi thu bo pradzñā rak+ṣi ti'i gzhung gzhir byas/ da ri ka dang*/ a bha ya dang*/ mai tri pa/ shu bhā ka ra gup+ta sogs dang*/ bod kyi snga phyi'i bla ma mang po'i gsung gis brgyan/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bla ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa dag gis gnad nas bzung ste/ rgyu mtshan yid ches can du bris/ de yang dang por/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng ba la lhod pa mi mnga' ba rin po che ka bzhi pas bde mchog gi bla mchod bsdus pa zhig gyis zhes bskul bas mchod brjod tsam 'phral du bris pa las/ gzhan du le los phyir shol ba la/ bar du yang dad ldan mang po bdag gis bskul ba dang*/ phyis bla ma'i bkas 'phral du bskul bas 'dus shing 'khyer bde bar thun gnyis la myur bar sbyar te/ tā ra nā tha sa rang lo nyer gsum gyi dang por nag pa'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun la'o// maṅga laṃ ku ru ban+tu shu bha ma stu sarba dzā ga taṃ/ zhus dag/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga skal ba bzang po'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 10--PAGE 11--PAGE 1-
